notes: Answers now type out as they are written instead of appearing all at once. Idle processor use is down from about half a core to under three percent. Seven reading fonts to choose from, the file viewer zooms with Ctrl and the wheel, and a whole reply can be selected and copied in one drag. Pasted screenshots are no longer stored as message text, which was making chat files enormous. Handoffs no longer fail on a name already in use and say so instead of opening blank.
